# Polars Genson

> Infer a schema from JSON string columns and normalise them into typed Polars columns

polars-genson infers a schema from a column of JSON strings in a Polars DataFrame or Parquet file, then normalises every row to it, so JSON whose rows differ in shape becomes consistent typed Polars columns.

## Getting started

- [Getting started](https://lmmx.github.io/polars-genson/pr-preview/pr-318/get_started/index.md): Installation and a quickstart

## Guides

- [Infer a schema](https://lmmx.github.io/polars-genson/pr-preview/pr-318/guides/infer-schema/index.md): Infer a Polars schema, JSON Schema or Avro schema from a JSON column
- [Normalise a column](https://lmmx.github.io/polars-genson/pr-preview/pr-318/guides/normalise/index.md): Normalise a JSON column into typed columns, a struct column or JSON strings
- [JSON in Parquet](https://lmmx.github.io/polars-genson/pr-preview/pr-318/guides/parquet/index.md): Normalise a JSON string column in a Parquet file straight to typed Parquet output
- [Factor out repeated data](https://lmmx.github.io/polars-genson/pr-preview/pr-318/guides/extract-invariants/index.md): Move data repeated per key (embedded copies of referenced records) into a lookup table
- [Remove malformed records](https://lmmx.github.io/polars-genson/pr-preview/pr-318/guides/prune/index.md): Remove records holding named fields (malformed entries) and keep them in a separate file
- [Large inputs](https://lmmx.github.io/polars-genson/pr-preview/pr-318/guides/large-inputs/index.md): Speed and memory for large inputs

## How it works

- [Type mapping](https://lmmx.github.io/polars-genson/pr-preview/pr-318/concepts/type-mapping/index.md): Which Polars dtype each kind of JSON value becomes
- [Nulls and empty values](https://lmmx.github.io/polars-genson/pr-preview/pr-318/concepts/nulls-and-empty-values/index.md): Missing keys, null values, empty arrays and objects, null rows
- [Maps and records](https://lmmx.github.io/polars-genson/pr-preview/pr-318/concepts/maps-and-records/index.md): When an object becomes a struct or a list of key/value structs
- [Mixed types](https://lmmx.github.io/polars-genson/pr-preview/pr-318/concepts/mixed-types/index.md): What happens when one field holds different kinds of value
- [Field order](https://lmmx.github.io/polars-genson/pr-preview/pr-318/concepts/key-order/index.md): How fields are ordered, and combining output from several inputs
- [How inference works](https://lmmx.github.io/polars-genson/pr-preview/pr-318/concepts/inference/index.md): How genson builds one schema from the rows, then rewrites it into maps and records
